artist: Alexander Francis Lydon (drawn); colour-printed by Benjamin Fawcett
work: William Thomas Greene, Parrots in Captivity, with notes on several species by the Hon. and Rev. F. G. Dutton (London: George Bell and Sons, 1884-1887), 3 vols, royal octavo
artist_credit_on_plate: none on the plate; the vol. III text credits 'Mr. Lydon' for the portraits, and the work is dedicated to Benjamin Fawcett, who colour-printed the plates
attribution_note: Lydon's authorship of the Parrots in Captivity plates is the standard attribution and is stated in the vol. III text; the plates themselves are unsigned.
colour_note: The breast is printed a strong scarlet rather than the galah's rose-pink; crest, grey wings and tail are correct.
copy: Smithsonian Libraries copy, digitised for the Biodiversity Heritage Library (Internet Archive ParrotscaptivitIGree)
licence: Public domain (published 1884; artist died 1917, printer 1893; BHL/IA: 'no longer under copyright protection')
processing: JP2 -> RGB, resized to 900 px tall (Lanczos), JPEG quality 85, no crop (tools/make_plate.py)
